title: Marketplace quick copy proofs and risk gates
content:
Purpose:
A compact, actionable sketch for last-mile marketplace listing copy + a minimal set of acceptance gates so we can unblock partner tile submission this sprint. Focus is on: clear customer promise, measurable QA, and fast fallbacks if legal/telemetry fails.

Context / why this doc exists:
- We keep iterating tile copy across regions; engineering needs a small, definitive set of copy variants and pass/fail checks to validate a listing before publishing.
- This is intended as a lightweight alternative to the full Listing Playbook when time-to-publish is <= 3 weeks.

Primary audience:
- Marketplace ops, partner PMs, partner engineering, copywriter on-call, legal reviewer (light).

Scope (what this doc covers):
- Short tagline options, 1-line benefits, 30/60/90 char microcopy (tile title/subtitle/button)
- Minimal acceptance gates (content, legal, telemetry, image assets, sku mapping)
- Smoke tests to run after publish + rollback triggers
- Quick fallback options (if legal/region or telemetry issues emerge)

Tile copy variants (pick 2 for A/B):
1) Variant A (developer-first):
  - Title (<= 45 chars): "Redwood Inference — Fast, predictable LLM serving"
  - Subtitle (<= 110 chars): "Run low-latency text, chat, and embeddings at scale with single API and optional private deployment."
  - CTA: "Try hosted API"
2) Variant B (cost-performance):
  - Title: "Reduce inference cost — flexible GPU runtime"
  - Subtitle: "Autoscaling reserved capacity and intelligent batching to cut per-token spend."
  - CTA: "Estimate savings"
3) Variant C (enterprise/compliance):
  - Title: "Private deployments & enterprise controls"
  - Subtitle: "VPC, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit logs for regulated workloads."
  - CTA: "Request demo"

Microcopy constraints (hard):
- No product claims about "best" or exact uptime % (legal will rewrite if used).
- Avoid naming unverified third-party integrations in tile copy (put in listing detail page instead).
- For EU/DE/FR markets, remove words "on-prem" and use "private deployment" per localization note.

Acceptance gates (must be green before publish):
- Content: selected variant approved by PM + engineering contact (explicit sign-off in Slack thread).
- Legal: any regulated claim flagged -> either removed or approved by Legal reviewer. (Legal sign-off required if words like "HIPAA" or "SOC2" are present.)
- Assets: tile image exists in repo (assets/marketplace/tile-redwood-v3.png) and matches aspect ratio 4:3; alt text provided.
- SKU mapping: SKU assigned and mapped to trial entitlement in billing sheet (billing-skus.csv).
- Telemetry hooks: marketplace-click, listing_impression, trial_start events instrumented and QA testable.
- Region policy: data residency copy verified for selected region(s).

Smoke test checklist (post-publish, 0-48h):
- Verify listing_impression pings within 5s of page load for sample UA (mobile & desktop).
- Click CTA (trial/demo) generates marketplace-click with correct sku and partner id.
- Trial provisioning executes end-to-end (no manual step) for a sample test tenant.
- Visual sanity: thumbnail, title, subtitle render correctly on narrow viewport.
- Link check: all links in listing detail page return 200 within 3s.

Rollback triggers (immediate revert if any of the below):
- Legal notifies product/ops of prohibited claim after publish.
- Telemetry missing for >50% of impressions in first hour in primary region.
- Broken trial provisioning for >3 test runs.
- Gross visual mismatches (wrong image or truncated title) reported by partners.

Minimum telemetry events to implement (names & minimal fields):
- listing_impression {listing_id, region, timestamp, variant}
- marketplace_click {listing_id, sku, user_id?, referrer}
- trial_start {sku, tenant_id, success_boolean, duration_ms}
- Note: user_id is optional/hashed for privacy; if present must be PII-scrubbed.

Legal / Compliance quick checklist: (fast checks only)
- Any mention of security/compliance gets immediate Legal review (HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC2).
- If we list encryption at rest, include KMS integration name only after partner engineering confirms availability.
- Short privacy blurb on detail page: "Your data is handled per our privacy policy" + link.

Localization notes (quick wins):
- Avoid idiomatic expressions. Keep sentences short for translation fidelity.
- Provide separate CTA suggestions for each locale (e.g., DE: "Jetzt testen", FR: "Demander une démo").

Image & creative requirements:
- Tile image: PNG/JPG, 1200x900 (4:3), under 250KB, brand-safe (no photos of people unless partner approved).
- Alt text: 10-15 words describing visual (for accessibility).
- If partner logo used, confirm clear-space rules and supply SVG.

Edge cases and fallback plans (if gate fails):
- If Legal blocks compliance claim: publish without claim + add "contact sales" CTA, file legal review ticket for rewording.
- If telemetry hooks fail: publish with "contact sales" CTA and flag ops to run manual metric collection for 72h.
- If image missing: use default brand background + generic icon and mark as temporary in listing metadata.

Operational notes (who runs what):
- Partner PM: owns final variant selection and sign-off for copy.
- Marketplace ops: runs preflight checklist and executes publish.
- Partner engineering: confirms SKU mapping and trial provisioning.
- Legal: asynchronous review within 48 hours for any compliance/security claims.

Unresolved questions / decision log (quick):
- Q: CTA language for cost-focused variant — "Estimate savings" vs "Estimate cost"?
  - MEASURE: A/B for click-through and trial conversion; start with "Estimate savings".
- Q: Accept partner-provided customer logos on tile?
  - DECISION: Not in initial tile; permit on detail page after logo validation.

Quick timeline (lean path):
- Day 0: copy variant chosen, assets uploaded, SKU assigned.
- Day 1: legal + telemetry hooks reviewed.
- Day 2: staging publish & smoke tests.
- Day 3: go-live if smoke tests pass.

Next steps / TODOs:
- @Evan Li: hook up listing_impression event and confirm sample events in dev account (by 2025-02-21).
- @Priya Kapoor: confirm localization strings for DE/FR/JP (by 2025-02-24).
- @Daniel Ortiz: upload tile image variants and alt text (by 2025-02-20).
- @Maya Chen: open Legal ticket for compliance language (JIRA-4237) and ping for 48h review.

Notes to self (looser):
- Keep this doc intentionally small — one page to read in 3 mins.
- If partner wants custom tile layout, route to design sprints, not this quick path.

Revision history:
- 2025-02-18: initial draft (Maya)
- 2025-02-20: added telemetry checklist and smoke tests (Evan)
- 2025-03-06: clarified rollback triggers and localization TODOs (Maya)

End.
